goal: Generate a cartoon-style corporate structure poster combining a pyramid and relationship network, in a 3:4 ratio, with a humorous title that is not insulting to individuals.

ip.name: "Cloud Council" fictional roundtable: AI and consumer hardware summit dialogue
ip.tone: Modern corporate poster + chibi-style avatar + light comic line art

characters.user_list: Sam Altman、Jensen Huang、Sundar Pichai、Tim Cook、Elon Musk、Mark Zuckerberg、Bill Gates、Warren Buffett

components: Only surname in uppercase English + Chinese title joke label.

composition.structure: Pyramid: top tier single card 'Think Tank' abstract icon, middle upper tier Sam Altman and Sundar Pichai side by side, middle lower tier Jensen Huang and Elon Musk on both sides, bottom row Tim Cook, Mark Zuckerberg, Bill Gates, Warren Buffett distributed like a base.
composition.hierarchy: The closer to the top, the larger the card, indicating topic weight rather than actual position level

types.name: Collaboration between computing power and models

relationships.annotation_rule: Short Mixed Chinese and English Terms Next to the Line, Such as 'API' 'OEM'

title_block.main_title: Cloud Board: Imagination that cannot be captured in a single image.
title_block.subtitle: Purely Creative Puzzle, Unrelated to Real Company Reporting

style.art_style: Flat commonly used UI colors + soft shadows + Q-version avatar.
style.color_palette: Light gray background, main colors do not exceed 5 distinct HEX blocks.

must_keep: Each avatar is in a distinguishable Q-version style, not realistic photography
Disclaimer: Legal and compliant, does not imply unverified scandals.
Line Does Not Cross Through Avatar Center
avoid: Information overload, too much text on a single card
Real company financial reports or stock price digits
